svg.title: Macrophages: phagocytosis, lysosomal biogenesis and vesicular trafficking
svg.text: Not to scale · molecular detail enlarged
cell ~20 µm · bacterium ~2 µm · receptor ~10 nm
Two routes converge to destroy microbes; persistent injurious particles can sustain inflammation and fibrosis.
